name: @mila/cli
description: Mila CLI — initialize Mila UI/UX toolkit in any project (shadcn-style component setup)

scripts.build: bun run build:bundle && bun run build:types
scripts.build:bundle: tsc --outDir dist --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --target ES2022 --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop src/index.ts && mkdir -p dist/bin && printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\nimport "../index.js";\n' > dist/bin/mila.js && chmod +x dist/bin/mila.js
